title: Hablar de tu familia
communication_goal: Nombrar familiares y decir quiénes forman parte de tu familia.
situation: Muestras una foto o describes tu familia a un compañero nuevo.

dialogue.speaker: Marco
dialogue.english: This is my mother. Her name is Rosa.
dialogue.spanish: Esta es mi madre. Se llama Rosa.

dialogue.speaker: Marco
dialogue.english: They are my brother and sister.
dialogue.spanish: Son mi hermano y mi hermana.

dialogue.speaker: Lia
dialogue.english: Do you have a big family?

dialogue.speaker: Marco
dialogue.english: No, I don't. My family is small.

explanation_es: Para presentar una persona usa This is my + familiar: This is my mother. Para varias personas usa These are my parents. Pregunta Who is this? para una persona y Who are they? para varias. My indica posesión: my mother, my brother, my family.
spanish_speaker_notes: Family puede ser singular como grupo: My family is small.
Parents siempre es plural: My parents are...
No uses this are; this es singular y these es plural.
Brother/sister son relaciones familiares; cousin significa primo o prima.

pronunciation.tip_es: Practica señalando una foto: una persona = this is; varias = these are.

reading.title: Marco's family
reading.text: Marco has a small family. He has one brother and one sister. His mother is Rosa and his father is Luis. His parents live nearby. Marco loves his family.

activities.instruction: Relaciona cada familiar con su significado.
Escucha: These are my parents. Elige la imagen o descripción adecuada.

activities.feedback: Una persona singular usa This is.
Para varias personas usamos These are.
Parents es plural y necesita are.

activities.instruction: Describe una foto ficticia: This is my mother. These are my parents.
activities.target: This is my mother. These are my parents.

activities.instruction: Lee Marco's Family y responde: How many siblings does Marco have?
activities.answer: He has one brother and one sister.
activities.feedback: Brother y sister son sus dos hermanos.

activities.instruction: La IA será un compañero viendo una foto familiar ficticia. Presenta cinco personas y pregunta Who is this?/Who are they?.
activities.scenario: Talking about a fictional family photo.
activities.ai_language: English; avoid asking for real private family details

activities.instruction: Crea un árbol familiar ficticio y graba seis frases para presentarlo.
Completa: This is my ___. These are my ___. He is my ___. She is my ___.

mastery_criteria.retry: Si confundes singular y plural, señala una persona o varias y elige this is o these are.
